title: Wren and the Thorn
author: Orsen Okafor
blurb: Oscar Halloran, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
